title: A SAT-based Filtering Framework for Exact Coverings of K33 by Cliques of Order 3, 4 or 5
summary: We investigate the minimum number of cliques of orders $3$, $4$, and $5$ needed to cover the edges of $K_{33}$ with zero excess. General covering results yield the lower bound 57. The main result of the paper is that no decomposition of $K_{33}$ into $57$ blocks from $\{K_3,K_4,K_5\}$ exists. Our approach is algorithmic and relies on a layered exact-search pipeline rather than a single monolithic solver.
